texture.heightmap.summary: Generate a deterministic, tileable PNG heightmap (strips, grooves, waves or value noise) with no product hardcoding and no third-party imaging dependency.
limitations: 8-bit single-channel grayscale PNG. The PNG is written to the Fusion host. The same parameters reproduce byte-identical pixels (deterministic hash). Value noise is a fixed hash, not a physics-based height field.

inputs.path: Required absolute .png output path on the Fusion host; existing parent required.
inputs.pattern: strips, grooves, waves, or noise; default waves.
inputs.tileable: Boolean, default true; wraps the field for seamless tiling.
inputs.overwrite: Existing output requires true AND confirm true.
